scripts.copy-docs-screenshots: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src=path.join(process.cwd(),'../../docs/screenshots');const dest=path.join(process.cwd(),'public/docs/screenshots');if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.mkdirSync(dest,{recursive:true});fs.readdirSync(src).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.png')).forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync(path.join(src,f),path.join(dest,f)));console.log('Screenshots copied');} else console.warn('docs/screenshots not found');"
scripts.build:prod: vite build && vite build --config vite.embed.config.js && node scripts/verify-build-env.js
